gloss: as one wishes; as expected; the way one wants

definitions.gloss: as one wishes; as one expects; the way one intended or hoped
definitions.explanation: Describes a situation or outcome that matches what someone wanted, planned, or envisioned. Can be used both when things go well and when lamenting that things did not go as hoped.

examples.japanese: {思|おも}い{通|どお}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧いかないこと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Sometimes things don't go as planned.

examples.japanese: ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{思|おも}い{通|どお}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: The plan is progressing just as expected.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{思|おも}い{通|どお}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{泣|な}き{出|だ}す→泣き出す：06343_nakidasu⟧。
examples.english: The child starts crying when things don't go their way.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{実|みの}り→実る：00282_minoru⟧、{思|おも}い{通|どお}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Years of effort bore fruit, and I was able to get the results I had hoped for.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧ (thought, wish) + {通|どお}り (in accordance with). Almost always used with the particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ to form the adverbial phrase {思|おも}い{通|どお}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧. Very common in everyday Japanese. The negative pattern {思|おも}い{通|どお}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧いかない (things don't go as planned) is especially frequent.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {思|おも}い{通|どお}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to go as one wants
- {思|おも}い{通|どお}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧: to not go as one wants
- {思|おも}い{通|どお}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧いく: to go as planned
- {思|おも}い{通|どお}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧いかない: to not go as planned
- {思|おも}い{通|どお}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧: the result one hoped for

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{予想|よそう}{通|どお}り→予想通り：16795_yosoudoori⟧: as expected — based on prediction rather than desire
- ⟦{期待|きたい}{通|どお}り→期待通り：15320_kitaidoori⟧: as hoped — close synonym, emphasizes expectation
- ⟦{思|おも}うがまま→思うがまま：25837_omougamama⟧: as one pleases — more literary; emphasizes freedom of action rather than outcomes matching wishes
- ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧{通|どお}り: according to plan — focuses on following a specific plan
